excrement.definition: n waste matter (as urine or sweat but especially feces) discharged from the body
excrement.translation:
n. 排泄, 大便
[医] 粪便

excremental.definition: a. Of or pertaining to excrement.
excremental.translation: a. 排泄物的, 粪便的

excrementitial absorption.translation: [医] 排泄物吸收, 病理吸收

excrementitious.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or consisting of, excrement; of the
   nature of excrement.
excrementitious.translation: a. 粪便的, 排泄物的

excrescence.definition: n. (pathology) an abnormal outgrowth or enlargement of some part of the body
excrescence.translation:
n. 瘤, 赘生物, 自然长出物(如指甲、头发)
[医] 赘生物, 赘疣

excrescences.definition:
n. something that bulges out or is protuberant or projects from its surroundings
n. (pathology) an abnormal outgrowth or enlargement of some part of the body
excrescences.translation: n. 瘤, 赘生物( excrescence的复数形式 )

excrescency.translation: n. 赘生物, 瘤, 赘疣

excrescent.definition: a. forming an outgrowth (usually an excessive outgrowth)
excrescent.translation:
a. 多余的, 赘音的, 外加音的
[医] 赘疣样的, 赘生物的

excrescential.definition: a. Pertaining to, or resembling, an excrescence.

excreta.definition: n waste matter (as urine or sweat but especially feces) discharged from the body
excreta.translation:
n. 排泄物
[医] 排泄物, 分泌物

excrete.translation:
vt. 排泄, 分泌
[医] 排泄, 分泌

excreted.translation: v. 排除( excrete的过去式和过去分词 ); 排泄; 分泌; 排出

excretes.translation: v. 排除( excrete的第三人称单数 ); 排泄; 分泌; 排出

excretin.definition:
n. A nonnitrogenous, crystalline body, present in small
   quantity in human faeces.

excreting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Excrete
excreting.translation: v. 排除( excrete的现在分词 ); 排泄; 分泌; 排出

excretion.definition:
n the bodily process of discharging waste matter
n waste matter (as urine or sweat but especially feces) discharged from the body
excretion.translation:
n. 排泄, 分泌, 排泄物
[医] 排泄, 分泌

excretions.definition:
plural of excretion
n the bodily process of discharging waste matter
n waste matter (as urine or sweat but especially feces) discharged from the body
excretions.translation:
(excretion 的复数) n. 排泄, 分泌, 排泄物
[医] 排泄, 分泌

excretive.definition: a. Having the power of excreting, or promoting excretion.
excretive.translation: a. 排泄的, 分泌的, 促进排泄的

excretory.definition: a. of or relating to the process of excretion
excretory.translation:
a. 排泄的, 分泌的, 排泄物的
[医] 排泄的

excruciate.definition:
v torment emotionally or mentally
v subject to torture
excruciate.translation: vt. 施酷刑, 拷问, 使苦恼, 折磨

excruciated.translation: v. （精神上）残酷折磨, （使精神上受）极大痛苦( excruciate的过去式和过去分词 )

excruciates.definition:
v torment emotionally or mentally
v subject to torture
excruciates.translation: v. （精神上）残酷折磨, （使精神上受）极大痛苦( excruciate的第三人称单数 )

excruciating.definition:
v torment emotionally or mentally
v subject to torture
s extremely painful
excruciating.translation: a. 极痛苦的, 折磨人的, 精心制作的

excruciatingly.definition: r in a very painful manner
excruciatingly.translation: adv. 极痛苦地, 难忍受的

excruciation.definition:
n a state of acute pain
n the infliction of extremely painful punishment or suffering
excruciation.translation:
n. 酷刑, 苦楚, 苦恼, 剧痛, 拷问
[法] 酷刑, 拷打, 苦恼

excruciator.translation: n. 施酷刑者, 拷打者；折磨别人者

excruciators.translation: (excruciator 的复数) n. 施酷刑者, 拷打者；折磨别人者
